text: Deadlines are a part of professional life, but they don't have to be stressful. The first step is good time management. Break a large project into smaller, manageable tasks, and set mini-deadlines for each one. Next, learn to prioritize. Not every task is urgent, so focus on the most important ones first. Scope management is also vital; it's easy for a small job to grow. Be clear about what is included and what is not. Finally, communication is key. If you think you will be late, tell your manager or client early. People usually appreciate honesty, and you may find a solution together.
